criteria.statement: SoulFactory loads, validates, normalizes, and deduplicates Communikeys community pubkeys and non-empty section names.
Assignment queries the exact admin-authored kind-30000 coordinate, accepts only a valid signed list with exactly one matching d tag, and resolves latest-wins deterministically.
A missing agent p tag is appended without dropping existing tags or content, and the replacement is signed by the configured community owner.
Relay authentication and OK outcomes are verified; missing lists, ownership mismatch, and rejected publication fail provisioning closed.
Communikeys assignment runs after Signet identity provisioning, is idempotent for existing members, and records assigned kind-30000 coordinates in the Signet step.
Documentation states that profile-list p tags grant write access and badges are engagement-only.
